castle-courtyard.name: Castle Courtyard
castle-courtyard.description: The castle courtyard is covered in deep snow. Freezing winds howl around the castle towers.

castle-hall.name: Royal Castle Hall
castle-hall.description: The grand castle hall. The fireplace is empty, and the King sits shivering on his throne.

fire-tome.name: Book of Elements
fire-tome.description: The Book of Elements, containing fire magic that can save the kingdom.

hot-elixir.name: Spiced Hot Elixir
hot-elixir.description: A steaming hot potion that can warm up anyone instantly.

castle-key.name: Castle Gate Key
castle-key.description: The ornate silver key to the Castle Hall.

hero.name: Alden
hero.description: A young hero seeking to save the kingdom.

gatekeeper.name: Gerald the Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.description: The gatekeeper guarding the Royal Castle Hall. He is shivering violently.

dialogues.before_talk: Gerald: Brrr... I am freezing to death out here. I cannot let anyone pass, nor can I turn the key with my hands frozen. If you have some hot elixir, please give it to me!
dialogues.after_talk: Gerald: Do you have the spiced hot elixir? I found a bottle in the courtyard, but my hands were too cold to grab it.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Gerald: Ah! The elixir warms my soul! Thank you, adventurer. Here is the Castle Gate Key. Go inside and save the King!
dialogues.hostile: Gerald: Halt! I'll defend this gate with my life, thief!

king.name: King Roderick
king.description: The ruler of the frozen kingdom, hoping for the return of the magical tome.

dialogues.before_talk: King Roderick: Traveler... do you bring the Book of Elements? The fires in our hearths have died, and my people are freezing...
dialogues.after_talk: King Roderick: Please, return the Book of Elements. We cannot survive another night.
dialogues.after_satisfied: King Roderick: The Book of Elements! You did it! The fires are lit again, and the winter thaw begins. You are the savior of our kingdom!
dialogues.hostile: King Roderick: Guard! Seize this traitor!
